name: Westfield Promenade
description: Westfield Promenade is a premier shopping destination in Woodland Hills, California, offering a dynamic mix of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Located in the heart of the San Fernando Valley, this Westfield property provides visitors with access to iconic brands and world-class amenities in a modern, convenient setting. The center serves as a community hub where shoppers can explore the latest fashion trends, enjoy diverse culinary experiences, and participate in engaging events throughout the year.
demographics: Affluent suburban families and professionals in the San Fernando Valley area, with high household incomes and diverse shopping preferences
summary: A premier Westfield shopping destination in Woodland Hills offering upscale retail, dining, and entertainment in the San Fernando Valley.
